items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: absolute top tier musicians and performers are Canadians. Drake, you know?

ctx.x: Wow did it seem obvious that you needed to go to the United States eventually?

Well yes. It seemed like a fantasy though, very difficult, I was aware, to do, to get the kind of credentials you needed to work legally in the U.S. as a Canadian. But it wasn’t like it is today. Certainly we look at today’s musical artists and we see that some of the top, absolute top tier musicians and performers are Canadians. Drake, you know? Need I
say more? And The Weeknd. Both Torontonians. It wasn’t like, Celine Dion, my goodness, we look at some of the huge impactful artists. In my day we had Lightfoot, Gordon Lightfoot, The Guess Who.
